meta.notes: POST /webhook/site-clone {action: start|status|cancel|source, url, options, campaign_id, job_id, sketch_id, opsec, proxy}. Starts an HTTrack clone in the site-clone-api container (options include deobfuscate / deobfuscateTimeout / allowDockerDns, forwarded as-is). The sidecar flattens the frontend proxy envelope and applies OPSEC DNS (proxychains proxy_dns, per-job resolv.conf / DoH stub, fail-closed). Polls status (including the dns label) and on completion writes findings into the campaign sketch and indexes the offline clone tree (mirror/ + deobf/ + ocr/) into the Prompt-tab company-site RAG collection. action=source returns a secret-scrubbed, read-only snippet of a deobf/ocr/mirror file so the Active findings pane can show recovered JavaScript in context. JS endpoints are ingested as WebAssets and same-registrable ones are correlated to the org's existing apex WebAsset. Live Domain Recon crawling stays removed. HTTP failures return JSON such as site-clone-api unreachable at <url> instead of a bare 500.
